_meta.change_protocol: CLO sign-off required for any change. Vishal raises Jira tickets to Ajay for additions; never edits unilaterally.

designation: IN THE COURT OF DISTRICT & SESSIONS JUDGE
jurisdictionNote: District-level criminal and civil courts in Rajasthan, governed by the Rajasthan Civil Courts Ordinance, 1950 and Rajasthan High Court Rules, 1952. Sessions courts try offences punishable with imprisonment exceeding 7 years. Rajasthan was reorganised in 2023, with 19 new districts notified — current count is 50 districts. Hindi is the official language of the State courts under the Rajasthan Official Language Act, 1956.

party_designation.state: State of Rajasthan through the Principal Secretary, Home Department, Government of Rajasthan, Jaipur

case_nomenclature.regular_bail: Crl. Misc. Bail Appln. No. _____ of {year}

prayer_language.opening: It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to:
prayer_language.closing: And for this act of kindness, the petitioner shall, as in duty bound, ever pray.

verification_format:
I, {deponent_name}, {designation}, do hereby solemnly verify and declare that the contents of the above petition from paragraph ___ to paragraph ___ are true to my personal knowledge and the contents of paragraphs ___ to ___ are believed to be true on the basis of information received and legal advice tendered, which I believe to be true. Nothing material has been concealed therefrom.

Verified at {place} on this {date}.

DEPONENT
localRules: Hindi is the official language of the Rajasthan subordinate courts; pleadings in English are accepted but Hindi translation may be insisted upon under the Rajasthan Official Language Act, 1956.
Bail applications under S.483 BNSS must disclose any earlier rejection by the Magistrate or any co-ordinate court.
Anticipatory bail applications (S.482 BNSS) must be accompanied by an affidavit, certified copy of the FIR and grounds of apprehension.
Vakalatnama in the form prescribed under the Rajasthan High Court Rules, 1952 to be filed at the first instance with requisite court-fee stamp.
All civil pleadings to be paginated, indexed and accompanied by a list of documents under Order VII / Order VIII CPC.
Court-fee under the Rajasthan Court-Fees and Suits Valuation Act, 1961.
Atrocities (SC/ST), POCSO and NDPS cases are tried by designated Special Courts notified by the State Government.

After the 2023 reorganisation, jurisdictional headquarters of several new districts (Anupgarh, Balotra, Beawar, Deeg, Didwana-Kuchaman, Dudu, Gangapur City, Jaipur Rural, Jodhpur Rural, Kekri, Khairthal-Tijara, Kotputli-Behror, Neem ka Thana, Phalodi, Salumbar, Sanchore, Shahpura) follow notifications issued by the Government of Rajasthan and the Rajasthan High Court.
e_filing_note: e-Filing is operational at Jaipur, Jodhpur and select district HQs via the eCourts portal; not yet mandatory state-wide.
